name: Takizawa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Takizawa city emblem in yellow: a ring crossed by a stylised lightning-like stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Takizawa, a city in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 October 1965.

features.role: Takizawa city emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised lightning-like stroke
